# te_pg_bsum, and the working_conditions table's value into te_pg_btab.
te_pg_building_sum_farmers = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_agriculture is_building_group = bg_staple_crops is_building_group = bg_subsistence_agriculture } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_agriculture_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_agriculture_farmers_mortality_mult } }

	if = {

# THIS = a building, a laborers pop's workplace: its groups' group-wide and laborers mortality reads into
# te_pg_bsum, and the working_conditions table's value into te_pg_btab.
te_pg_building_sum_laborers = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_agriculture is_building_group = bg_staple_crops is_building_group = bg_subsistence_agriculture } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_agriculture_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_agriculture_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_army is_building_group = bg_army_logistics_center is_building_group = bg_conscription } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_army_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_army_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_army_logistics_center }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_army_logistics_center_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_army_logistics_center_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_arts }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_arts_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_arts_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_banana_plantations }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_banana_plantations_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_banana_plantations_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_bureaucracy }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_bureaucracy_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_bureaucracy_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_canals }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_canals_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_canals_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_coal_mining }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_coal_mining_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_coal_mining_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}

# THIS = a building, a machinists pop's workplace: its groups' group-wide and machinists mortality reads into
# te_pg_bsum, and the working_conditions table's value into te_pg_btab.
te_pg_building_sum_machinists = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_agriculture is_building_group = bg_staple_crops is_building_group = bg_subsistence_agriculture } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_agriculture_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_agriculture_machinists_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_army is_building_group = bg_army_logistics_center is_building_group = bg_conscription } }

# THIS = a building, a officers pop's workplace: its groups' group-wide and officers mortality reads into
# te_pg_bsum, and the working_conditions table's value into te_pg_btab.

# THIS = a building, a peasants pop's workplace: its groups' group-wide and peasants mortality reads into
# te_pg_bsum, and the working_conditions table's value into te_pg_btab.

		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_agriculture is_building_group = bg_staple_crops is_building_group = bg_subsistence_agriculture } }
